label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — resolved sink value is rememberMeKey derived directly from new java.util.Random().nextInt(99) assigned to the cookie/session token used for authentication. The weak random generator feeds security-sensitive material (rememberMeKey) without sanitization. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value includes user-controlled strings (user, cookie names/values) concatenated into HTML response output. Both alerts represent real vulnerabilities on their respective paths.

evidence.note: Weak random number generation feeding authentication token
User input concatenated into HTML response without encoding
